title: Foundational Data Quality
definition: The critical importance of data quality and alignment with the target personality in character/personality training for language models.

difficulty_levels.beginner: For character training in AI, it's better to have a few high-quality examples than a lot of low-quality ones. The right data makes the difference, not the amount.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: In character/personality training, the foundational data should be high-quality, style-consistent examples that accurately represent the target personality. Noisy data can teach the model unwanted patterns.
difficulty_levels.expert: The foundational data in character/personality training plays a crucial role. Quality beats quantity, and noisy data can lead the model to learn undesired patterns. A systematic approach to data structure, such as decomposing personality into operational dimensions, can improve personality fidelity.

extra_fields.insight: The quality and structure of the foundational data are more important than the quantity in character/personality training for language models.
